kayitlar.normalize_mesaj: what is the digital maturity test
kayitlar.ham_mesaj: what is the digital maturity test
kayitlar.cevap: The Digital Maturity Test is an assessment tool that measures your company's level of digitalization across dimensions such as processes, technology, human resources, and strategy. IMPORTANT DISTINCTION: this test must not be confused with the TRL (Technology Readiness Level) test, which measures the readiness of a technology/R&D output - the digital maturity test is an ORGANIZATIONAL/sector-based assessment, while TRL is a TECHNOLOGY/R&D-focused assessment. The digital maturity test is applied across 5 different sectors and results in one of five levels (Starting, Basic, Intermediate, Advanced, Scalable).

IMPORTANT DISTINCTION: this test must not be confused with the TRL (Technology Readiness Level) test, which measures the readiness of a technology/R&D output - the digital maturity test is an ORGANIZATIONAL/sector-based assessment, while TRL is a TECHNOLOGY/R&D-focused assessment. The digital maturity test is applied across 5 different sectors and results in one of five levels (Starting, Basic, Intermediate, Advanced, Scalable).

kayitlar.mesaj: what is TRL
kayitlar.normalize_mesaj: what is trl
kayitlar.ham_mesaj: what is TRL
kayitlar.cevap: TRL (Technology Readiness Level) is an internationally recognized nine-level scale (1 to 9) that indicates the maturity stage of a technology or R&D output, from basic scientific research to commercial/operational use (originating from NASA, now used by many programs including the EU's Horizon Europe). IMPORTANT DISTINCTION: TRL measures the readiness of a TECHNOLOGY/R&D project; DDX's digital maturity test measures a COMPANY's organizational/sector-based digitalization level - the two are not interchangeable.
